parrafo_1.es: Golda's Place es un negocio familiar de Ocala, identificado en Google como propiedad de mujer y de familia latina. Trabajamos la cocina puertorriqueña de siempre: tripleta, papas locas y smash burgers, preparados al momento en el truck.
parrafo_1.en: Golda's Place is a family-run Ocala business, listed on Google as women-owned and Latino-owned. We cook real Puerto Rican food: tripleta, papas locas and smash burgers, made to order right at the truck.

parrafo_2.es: El trabajo habla solo: 5.0 de calificación con 30 reseñas en Google de clientes que vuelven una y otra vez por el mismo sabor.
parrafo_2.en: The work speaks for itself: a 5.0 rating from 30 Google reviews, from customers who keep coming back for the same flavor every time.

texto.es: Estamos en 187 Marion Oaks Blvd, Ocala, de jueves a sábado de 11:30 AM a 7:00 PM.
texto.en: We're parked at 187 Marion Oaks Blvd, Ocala, Thursday through Saturday, 11:30 AM to 7:00 PM.

texto.es: Llámanos al (352) 346-1917 para pedir con tiempo, o simplemente pasa por la ventanilla.
texto.en: Call us at (352) 346-1917 to order ahead, or just walk up to the window.

texto.es: Tripleta, papas locas, smash burger o pollo frito: dinos qué se te antoja.
texto.en: Tripleta, papas locas, smash burger or fried chicken: tell us what you're craving.

texto.es: Todo se prepara al momento en el truck. Comes ahí mismo o te lo llevas.
texto.en: Everything is made to order right at the truck. Eat right there or take it to go.

nota.es: Precios de pickup directo en el food truck. Llama para confirmar el menú del día.
nota.en: Pickup prices at the truck. Call ahead to confirm the day's menu.

texto.es: Cerdo asado, jamón y carne de res en capas con queso, lechuga, tomate y papitas, bañada en salsa de la casa.
texto.en: Roast pork, ham and beef layered with cheese, lettuce, tomato and shoestring fries, drizzled in house sauce.

texto.es: Papas fritas crujientes cubiertas de carne desmenuzada sazonada y una mezcla de salsas cremosas. Chica, mediana o grande.
texto.en: Crispy fries topped with seasoned shredded meat and a blend of creamy sauces. Small, medium or large.

texto.es: Doble smash burger con queso derretido, servido con papas fritas y bandera boricua de regalo.
texto.en: Double smash patties with melted cheese, served with fries and a Puerto Rican flag pick.

texto.es: Tres piezas de pollo frito crujiente, servidas con papas fritas y tu salsa favorita.
texto.en: Three pieces of crispy fried chicken, served with fries and your favorite dipping sauce.

pie.es: También hacemos combo Tripleta + Papas Locas por $22.50, batidas de la casa y café con leche. Salsas disponibles: Mayoketchup, Golda's Sauce, Golda's Spicy y Pico de Gallo. Pide pickup en línea en order.online o llama al (352) 346-1917.
pie.en: We also make a Tripleta + Papas Locas combo for $22.50, house milkshakes and iced coffee. Sauces on hand: Mayoketchup, Golda's Sauce, Golda's Spicy and Pico de Gallo. Order pickup online at order.online or call (352) 346-1917.

items.quote: Stopped by Golda’s Place and was seriously impressed. The food was delicious, portions were generous, prices were very reasonable, and the service was fast. One of the best food truck experiences I’ve had in Ocala. If you’re nearby, you have to try it.

The best food truck in Ocala! This place is definitely a must-visit. Great food, large portion at great prices. I have been eating here many times and have never been disappointed, it just gets better each time. I would definitely recommend this place.
For shows going to be one of my favorite places super friendly family environment love it you're the best
